verdicts.note: Hand-drawn 1752 map of the Mirgorod/Poltava area listing villages (Дереївка, Манзурівка, Бутівка) with church sketches; a map, not the site.

Sandy two-track road through pines and shrubs; a forest track, nothing that identifies the site.

Sandy clearing opening onto a dirt road at the edge of the forest; ordinary landscape, no ruins or structures.
